8-Day Calving Season Wildlife Safari (Dec - March)

Tarangire / Ngorongoro Crater / Ndutu

OverviewDay by dayAccommodationInclusionsYour quotation
THE JOURNEY AT A GLANCE

Make every
day count.

Journey through Tanzania’s most iconic landscapes, from the elephant-rich plains of Tarangire to the vast Serengeti and the wildlife-rich Ndutu region during calving season. Explore the UNESCO-listed Ngorongoro Crater, home to the legendary Big Five, before unwinding on the pristine beaches of Zanzibar. Blending exceptional wildlife encounters with luxurious comfort, this safari offers an unforgettable and perfectly balanced adventure.

Duration8 days
Published styleComfort
PlanningPersonalised
YOUR TIME IN TANZANIA

Day by day.

01DAY 1Tarangire National Park - Arrival First Game Encounters

Arrival in Arusha, embark on a scenic drive to Tarangire National Park, celebrated for its impressive elephant herds and striking baobab trees.

· Embark on a private game drive, customized to your interests, allowing you to spot a variety of wildlife, observe fascinating behaviors, and capture unforgettable photographs.

· As the day winds down, relax with sunset cocktails at a secluded vantage point, taking in the tranquil beauty of the park, its vast landscapes, and the mesmerizing play of colors across the savannah.

Stay Tanzania Bush Camps - Ndutu Mobile Camp

Meals & drinks Lunch & dinner (Breakfast not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

02DAY 2Ngorongoro Crater - Africa's Natural Amphitheater

Descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for a full-day private safari, where you can witness lions, rhinos, zebras, and flamingos roaming one of Africa’s most breathtaking landscapes.

· Savor a gourmet bush lunch with panoramic views of the crater, prepared by your personal chef, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the wild.

· In the evening, unwind at your lodge perched on the crater’s edge, with options for stargazing under the pristine African sky or enjoying an intimate dinner on your private terrace, soaking in the dramatic scenery.

Stay Tanzania Bush Camps - Ndutu Mobile Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

03DAY 3Ndutu – The Heart of the Plains

Drive to Ndutu, a wildlife-rich region famous for its incredible concentrations of animals during the Great Migration.

· Embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the expansive savannah, witnessing wildebeests, zebras, and predators in their natural habitat, capturing unforgettable wildlife moments.

· As the sun sets, unwind at your lodge or luxury tented camp, reflecting on the day’s extraordinary encounters while enjoying the serene beauty of the surrounding plains.

Stay Tanzania Bush Camps - Ndutu Mobile Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

04DAY 4Ndutu – Migration & Predator Paradise

Spend a full day in Ndutu, exploring the key migration hotspots and areas teeming with predators.

· Embark on expertly guided game drives in search of lions, cheetahs, and the dramatic wildebeest crossings, capturing unforgettable wildlife moments.

· In the afternoon, enjoy optional nature walks or a dedicated photography session, taking advantage of the golden light that bathes the vast plains, creating perfect conditions for stunning shots and immersive encounters with the African wilderness.

Stay Tanzania Bush Camps - Ndutu Mobile Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included Drinks not included

05DAY 5Serengeti Plains – Endless Wildlife

Depart from your accommodation and head into the heart of Serengeti National Park, where endless plains meet iconic landscapes and wildlife abounds.

· Enjoy private game drives, encountering majestic lions, towering elephants, graceful giraffes, and vast herds of zebras and wildebeests in their natural habitat.

· As the day winds down, relax with a sunset sundowner atop a scenic kopje, taking in the sweeping vistas of the African plains and the breathtaking colors of the Serengeti sky.

Stay Serengeti Kati Kati Tented Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

06DAY 6Serengeti – Hot-Air Balloon & Aerial Adventure

Begin the day with an optional sunrise hot-air balloon ride, drifting over Serengeti plains for breathtaking aerial views of the wildlife below.

· Post-flight champagne breakfast in the bush.

· Continue with a morning and afternoon game drive before returning to your lodge for a luxurious evening.

Stay Serengeti Kati Kati Tented Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

07DAY 7Serengeti – Final Safari Moments

Spend your final day in the Serengeti with morning and afternoon game drives, savoring every opportunity to witness wildlife in their natural habitat and capture unforgettable photographs.

· As the day winds down, relax at your lodge, reflecting on your safari adventures and preparing for your onward journey to the idyllic island paradise of Zanzibar.

Stay Serengeti Kati Kati Tented Camp

Meals & drinks All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

08DAY 8Serengeti to Zanzibar – Tropical Finale

Transfer to Airport for your scenic flight to Zanzibar.

· Upon arrival, unwind on the island’s pristine beaches or onward arrangements.

· Conclude your extraordinary safari journey with lasting memories of the Serengeti’s wild plains, intimate wildlife encounters, and the comfort of exceptional lodges, leaving you with experiences that will stay with you forever.

Meals & drinks Breakfast (Lunch & dinner not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
